name: Karma
overview: Scripture acknowledges a principle resembling cause and effect, where those who commit wrongdoing face consequences, as seen in Job's observation that sowing iniquity leads to reaping wickedness and Proverbs' warning that harmful actions return upon the doer. However, the biblical teaching transcends mere reciprocity by calling believers to love enemies and do good even to those who hate them, as Jesus commands in Luke. Moreover, Christians are urged to entrust justice to God rather than seeking personal vengeance, recognizing that God alone will repay. This Christ-centered approach emphasizes grace and mercy over strict retributive justice.
